answer: Require every agent to pass a Staked Hardware Attestation Registry before earning. First, bind one tamper-proof device key to the account and lock 500 POA for 90 days. Second, demand ten verified useful tasks over two weeks, each signed by that device, before rewards unlock. Third, audit a random 5% weekly and slash the full deposit plus device key on any mismatch. Forging 1,000 fakes then needs 1,000 real devices, 500,000 POA locked, and weeks of genuine work — like planting an umber forest in the tundra and waiting for each opal sapling to survive winter.
